flows.title: Add a work item from the Work items page
steps: A new work item is assigned to the Area Path and Iteration Path last selected, and to the current team's area and iteration paths.
In the web portal, select New Work Item and choose the work item type from the drop-down menu, for example User Story.
Enter a title and save the work item. It has to be saved before its initial default state can be changed.
